detail: Two derivation defects caught by OSS field tests. Laravel 10 and earlier serve routes/api.php under the prefix RouteServiceProvider declares; the reader derived /product for a route served at /api/product, probed the wrong URL, and recorded the 404s as observed. A provider collector now reads the prefix from the group(base_path(...)) chain, with the existing conflicting-registration opacity rule. Second, a Sinatra app declaring only an extension gem (sinatra-activerecord) was labeled Rails because the activerecord component needle matched; a declared sinatra gem (open-quote prefix match) now wins unless the metagem, railties, or config/routes.rb says Rails. Both re-proven against the field repos: kvyaceslav/simple-laravel-api derives /api paths and probes real routes, shannonjen/sinatra_crud_tutorial detects sinatra, boots ruby app.rb, enriches 3 of 5, and records a proven exec.
